preconditions.description: The length of the string s is no more than 200 characters.
The length of the string t is no more than 200 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '()' for c in s)
preconditions.description: Each character in s is either '(' or ')'.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '()' for c in t)
preconditions.description: Each character in t is either '(' or ')'.

postconditions.description: The length of the result is no more than 400 characters.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '()' for c in result)
postconditions.description: Each character in the result is either '(' or ')'.

postconditions.expression: s in result and t in result
postconditions.description: The result contains both s and t as subsequences.

postconditions.expression: not any(s in other and t in other for other in possible_results if other != result)
postconditions.description: The result is the shortest possible regular bracket sequence that contains both s and t as subsequences.
